subject.title: feat(chat): rewind and fork a session from a message bubble

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor these two additive public session-history RPCs and their Control UI workflow after the protocol registry and real-behavior proof gates are satisfied?
rationale: The implementation introduces a durable public gateway/session-state capability, and the protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling rather than automated landing judgment.

options.title: Sponsor with contract completion
options.body: Require canonical protocol registration, generated-client refresh, and redacted live Control UI evidence, then continue normal feature review.

options.title: Narrow to internal UI behavior
options.body: Avoid exposing new public RPCs only if maintainers choose a supported internal session-mutation seam that preserves native-client contracts.

options.title: Pause the feature direction
options.body: Keep the proposal open but defer it if public transcript rewind/fork is not a desired supported session capability.

recommendation.title: Sponsor with contract completion
recommendation.body: Require canonical protocol registration, generated-client refresh, and redacted live Control UI evidence, then continue normal feature review.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context identifies steipete as the author of the feature design, although current-main ownership history could not be confirmed.
